verdict.rationale: The documented `npx skills add` route writes skills into the repo as ordinary files you own, and the docs state "Nothing updates behind your back": changes arrive only when you run `npx skills update`, which gives a lead explicit control over when updates reach the team. The hands-on probe confirms the copy-into-repo install works. The caveat is that the Claude Code and Codex plugin routes update themselves by default, so this control depends on choosing the copy install. missing for 10: an explicit version-pin or lockfile mechanism (e.g., installing a tagged release), a documented way to stop the plugin channels from auto-updating, and independent hands-on confirmation that `npx skills update` is the only update path.
